subject: RT-DETR deep learning algorithm
source_sentence: Exclusion criteria consisted of inability to cooperate with clinical examination and image acquisition, coexisting ocular surface pathologies (including pterygium and pinguecula), and any congenital craniofacial anomalies. A single researcher performed the eye landmark annotation using a custom-developed desktop application designed to ensure consistency. Image patches centered on each landmark were then cropped with a 10-pixel margin for training. Subsequently, a two-stage analysis pipeline was implemented: first , the RT-DETR deep learning algorithm was employed to automate landmark localization; second, seven machine learning classifiers were evaluated for strabismus detection . These classifiers utilized 30 predefined geometric ratios derived from the localized landmark coordinates as input features for binary classification.
